title: Classify Pi prompt asset directory owner
summary: Choose and record owner classification for src/adapters/pi/prompt-assets so asset files are not ambiguous adapter drift.

goal.outcome: Prompt asset paths have explicit ownership and no longer appear as ambiguous adapter/asset drift.
acceptance: Map or KB classifies src/adapters/pi/prompt-assets/** as current package prompt assets or records future src/pi/prompt-assets/** migration trigger.
Ownership mismatch warnings for the prompt asset directory clear or are covered by accepted deferral with trigger.
Prompt asset and prompt contract smoke evidence still passes or remains unaffected.
non_goals: Do not move prompt asset files unless implementation explicitly scopes a migration.
Do not restore generic CodeWiki skill surfaces.
